rationale: Price is sitting at 95.5% of today's range, just $0.13 below the session high, with the last five 1-minute candles showing extremely tight, low-volume consolidation — no directional momentum to trade against. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.05%, VIXY +4.63%), which creates headwind for a long near the high, while the stock has already absorbed that pressure and held elevated, making a short equally unattractive without a clear breakdown signal. With ATR of only $0.18 on 5-minute bars and the spread consuming a meaningful portion of any realistic move, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
